task_type: public navigation performance and interaction repair
requested_outcome: Make destination-card activation immediately understandable and materially faster without bulk-loading every destination, then publish and verify it on the existing VII site.
natural_destination: The recommended vacation destination cards on the VII homepage and their regional vacation result routes.
authorization_boundary: Read, implement, test and publish this focused repair to the existing VII Site while preserving domains, supplier data, secrets and unrelated behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: The exact click journey must work at its natural destination.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require browser evidence plus full affected-family regression.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user requested publication and certainty.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require exact public URL and release verification.

lesson_bundle.reason: This is a focused behavior and performance repair.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Preserve existing card content, routes and design family.

lesson_bundle.reason: Feedback should clarify the action without adding user decisions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: One immediate selected-card state and one fallback route loader.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A spinner is added but the route is not made faster.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Measure the real route and add intent-only warming before activation.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The selected route starts warming on intent and the card changes state immediately.

predicted_rejections.rejection: All destination pages are prefetched and the homepage becomes heavier.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep automatic Link prefetch disabled and warm only the card receiving pointer or keyboard intent.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The source and regression test retain prefetch=false and restrict router.prefetch to intent handlers.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The selected card works locally but the public release is not verified.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Treat local verification as a release candidate only.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The same interaction and destination are exercised on the exact public version after deployment.

midpoint_gate.trigger: After reproducing the source and measuring live route response, before changing shared navigation behavior.
checks: Measure at least two production destination routes.
Compare cosmetic feedback, server latency and client navigation hypotheses.

attack_questions: Does the card change before navigation?
Do regional pages retain one H1 and all languages?
Does the public release show the repair?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Timed click observation on the homepage card and its resulting regional route.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Full test suite, sitemap HTML checks and four-language loading states.

effectiveness.baseline: The user observed no acknowledgement and a wait that felt excessively long.
effectiveness.target: Immediate visible acknowledgement with an earlier route start and no homepage bulk-prefetch regression.
